(b) THEN ONE Markdown table consistent with the Lock: - [Source Word] | [Morphology] | [Reference Equivalent] | [Contextual Definition] | [Grammatical Role] Source Text: 16 guardai in alto e vidi le sue spalle 17 vestite già de' raggi del pianeta 18 che mena dritto altrui per ogne calle. Reference Translation (provided): I looked on high, and saw its shoulders clothed already with the rays of the planet that leadeth men aright along every path.

**Step 1 – Interpretation Lock (one bullet per source line)**
- **Line 16 – “guardai in alto e vidi le sue spalle”** → *There exists a speaker S who performed two successive perceptual actions: (i) S looked upward toward the high direction, and (ii) S saw the shoulders belonging to some entity X (the “its” in the English translation). The shoulders are the visual focus of the second action.*
- **Line 17 – “vestite già de' raggi del pianeta”** → *The shoulders identified in line 16 are in the state of being clothed (covered) by the rays that emanate from the planet P. The adverb “già” (already) asserts that this covering holds prior to or at the moment of the observation.*
- **Line 18 – “che mena dritto altrui per ogne calle.”** → *The planet P (the source of the rays) performs the action of leading (mena) people (“altrui”) straight (dritto) along every path (calle). The relative clause links the planet’s rays to the guiding function.*
